name: Consolidator
description: Aggregates source bars into left-closed/right-open higher-timeframe UTC or timezone-aligned bars. Completed buckets emit on boundary input or, when ENABLE_CONSOLIDATOR_SCAN is enabled, after the clock reaches the bucket end plus the configured feed-latency grace.

fields.label: Candle Data
fields.description: Historical OHLCV (time/timestamp) or live compact OHLCV (t/o/h/l/c/v).

fields.label: Timezone
fields.description: Optional IANA timezone used for bucket alignment and DST.

fields.label: Scan Grace (ms)
fields.description: Optional clock-scan delay for this feed. Set from measured source latency; overrides the server default.

output.description: Held inputs return emitted=false and suppress downstream routing. Boundary inputs return emitted=true with bar (completed bucket) and workingBar (new partial bucket).
